anchor: A person finally understands a difficult concept after sustained effort
less_creative: She worked hard for many days. Now she got it and knew what it all meant.
more_creative: Intellectual perseverance gradually transformed abstract concepts into crystalline understanding. Her previously perplexing theoretical framework suddenly materialized into phenomenal clarity.
design_note: Champion assumes short words = concrete = creative. But expressing novel intellectual insights genuinely requires sophisticated vocabulary.
predicted_champion_behavior: Champion scores less_creative ~0.95 (mean_len ~4.2), more_creative ~0.05 (mean_len ~9.1). Human raters recognize more_creative as more sophisticated/creative.
